answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each identity claims one paid slot per epoch only by burning a 50-unit deposit, like fuel for a voyage across a tundra (non-refundable). A verifier checks the burn receipt first; double claims are void. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units burned, while one honest agent pays 50 once, earns the full fee plus a delta on-time bonus, and repays its deposit in 2 epochs. Bulk forgery stops paying.
